terms.title: Terms & Conditions
terms.body:
About this website
Welcome to Sivan Films. This website introduces our advertising, film production, animation, media planning and immersive experience services. By using the website, please follow these terms and use the studio responsibly.

Project enquiries and quotations
Submitting an enquiry or speaking with our assistant does not confirm a booking. Availability, scope, deliverables, timelines and fees will be agreed separately in a written quotation or project agreement. Website examples are illustrative; final results depend on the agreed brief.

Payments, changes and cancellations
Payment milestones, taxes, revisions, cancellation charges and any refunds will be set out in your project quotation or agreement before work begins. Changes to the approved brief may affect cost and delivery dates. Contact our team to discuss any change or cancellation.

Creative work and ownership
The Sivan Films name, branding, website design and original creative material belong to Sivan Films or their respective owners. Please obtain permission before copying, distributing or commercially reusing them. Ownership and usage rights for commissioned work are defined in the project agreement. Third-party logos and examples remain the property of their owners and do not imply endorsement.

Materials you provide
Please provide accurate enquiry details and only share material you have permission to use. Do not submit passwords, payment card details or unnecessary sensitive personal information. Do not misuse forms, attempt unauthorised access or interfere with the website.

External services and assistant answers
WhatsApp, map links and other external services operate under their own terms and privacy policies. Our enquiry assistant provides general information based on website content; please confirm prices, availability and commitments directly with the team.

Website availability
We aim to keep information accurate and the website available, but content and features may change or be temporarily unavailable. Nothing on this page excludes rights or responsibilities that cannot lawfully be excluded. An agreed project contract governs the services provided for that project.

Updates and contact
We may update these terms and will show the revision date on this page. For questions about the website or a project, use the contact details below.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.body:
Who we are
Sivan Films operates this website to showcase our studio and respond to enquiries about our creative services. This policy explains how information is used when you explore the studio or contact us.

Information you share
Our project enquiry form collects your name, phone number or email, optional company name, selected service and project details. Questions sent to the studio assistant are processed to produce a reply. Please avoid including passwords, financial information or sensitive personal details in forms or chat.

How we use information
We use enquiry details to respond to your request, understand your requirements, prepare quotations and communicate about a potential project. We use assistant questions to provide relevant service information. Submitting an enquiry requests a response about that enquiry; it does not subscribe you to unrelated marketing.

Storage and access
Submitted project enquiries are stored in the website database and can be viewed by authorised administrators. The current studio assistant generates replies from website content without storing chat transcripts in the enquiry database. Hosting infrastructure may process technical information needed to deliver and protect the site. We do not sell enquiry information.

Cookies and browser storage
The studio saves explored-room progress in your browser local storage and keeps navigation state in browser history. You can clear saved progress through your browser settings. Administrator sign-in uses a session cookie to protect the content editor. The current website does not use advertising or analytics cookies.

External links and services
Choosing WhatsApp opens a third-party service. A WhatsApp enquiry is sent only when you choose to send it there. Map links and other external sites have their own privacy practices. Information you share with those services is governed by their policies.

Retention and your choices
Enquiries remain in our records until removed by the team. We review retention based on enquiry handling, project needs and applicable obligations. You can contact us to request access, correction or deletion of information you provided, withdraw permission for further enquiry follow-up, or raise a privacy concern. We will review your request and explain any information we need to retain for an ongoing project or legal obligation.

Security and younger visitors
Administrator access is restricted, but no online system can guarantee absolute security. This website is intended for business and project enquiries and is not directed at children. If a child has submitted personal information, a parent or guardian can contact us to request its removal.

Policy updates and privacy contact
We may revise this policy when the website or our practices change. The latest revision date appears above. For privacy questions and requests, contact Sivan Films using the email or phone below with the subject “Privacy request”.
